caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object, likely a mechanical tool or implement, centrally positioned against a plain, off-white or beige background. The object is composed of several parts: a long, straight handle on the right with a rounded end that has a hole, possibly for hanging or attachment. From the handle, a bent metal rod extends to the left, forming the body of the object which is supported by two short, downward-bending legs. Attached to this rod is a horizontal rectangular basket or tray-like structure made from twisted metal wires, which form parallel lines and connect to perpendicular supports at each end. The metal throughout appears to be a dark brownish or rusty color, showing signs of age. The object appears three-dimensional with shadows and highlights that provide a sense of volume and depth. There is minimal text near the object, reading “Frank McIntire” in small print.
